title: Toasts and pop-ups stay inside the window, below the header: several long build notifications stacked newest-first, wrapped, scrolling
about: Synthetic notifications (no game files): a failed character collect (the operator's Pokémon Shield report), failed builds with long reasons, a finished build and a grouped entry. $announce shows them as toasts the way trayTick does for new entries; $desk_toasts does the same in the desktop shell (its toast() and build-note cards).
announce: (() => { const ids = ['n6', 'n5', 'n4', 'n3', 'n2', 'n1']; ids.forEach(id => { const n = TRAY.notes.find(x => x.id === id); if (n) bnAnnounce(n); }); })()
announce_one: (() => { const n = TRAY.notes.find(x => x.id === 'n1'); if (n) bnAnnounce(n); })()
desk_toasts: (() => { buildNoteMsg({ id: 'n2', title: 'Build failed: DOA2 roster swap with every fighter replaced by a collection character (Dead or Alive 2)', body: 'RuntimeError: the roster writer refused slot fighter:Kasumi: the donor model has 212 bones, the slot allows 96; retarget it first or pick a donor with a simpler rig' }); buildNoteMsg({ id: 'n1', title: 'Collecting characters failed: Pokémon Shield', body: 'No native model reader for this game; no unrigged capture was substituted.' }); toast('⚠ Launch failed: Dead or Alive 2 (doa2_roster_59d8ed0e) on JAYBUILTFINALE: retroarch content not running after 30s · Reported as #1712, being investigated', 60000); toast('Task mode on · hermes/nous-portal', 60000); })()
